name: Sierra de Salamanca

known.via: English Wikipedia "Sierra de Salamanca" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Vino de Calidad con Indicación Geográfica, a Spanish tier above Vino de la Tierra and below DO.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Castile and León protected designation in Salamanca province, known for red wines from the native Rufete grape. Its wines carry the Vino de Calidad label, a Spanish tier between vino de la tierra and DO. Garnacha and Tempranillo are also allowed, along with Macabeo and Palomino for white.
